atelier.name: Atelier Ama
atelier.craft: Vegetable-tanned leather, cut and stitched by hand in a two-person studio.

loomhouse.name: Loom House
loomhouse.craft: Strip-woven and indigo-dyed textiles from a cooperative of eleven weavers.

fieldkit.name: Field Kit Supply
fieldkit.craft: Hard-wearing everyday kit, made in small runs and repaired for free.

products.title: Indigo strip throw
products.description: Seven hand-woven strips joined into one throw, dyed in natural indigo. 130 by 180 cm.

products.title: Market tote
products.description: A deep, open tote in vegetable-tanned leather that darkens with use. Fits a laptop and a day's shopping.

products.title: Canvas field jacket
products.description: Waxed cotton canvas, four front pockets and a cord collar. Built to be worn for ten years.

products.title: Card wallet
products.description: Three pockets, no stitching to come undone: folded and riveted from a single piece.

products.title: Aso-oke cushion cover
products.description: Narrow-loom aso-oke in undyed cotton with a fine indigo stripe. Envelope back, no zip.

products.title: Enamel camp mug
products.description: Steel with a glass enamel coat. Goes on a fire, in a bag, and through years of drops.

products.title: Natural belt
products.description: Undyed leather with a solid brass buckle. Starts pale and ages to honey.

products.title: Undyed table runner
products.description: A single long strip from the loom, left in natural cotton with knotted ends.
